about: What the paid plan prepares for each finding, shown on the free check's offer. 'prepared' must match complete_map.PLANS (offer_test.py checks). Prices and refund are the public offer and must match server/billing.py; change them only with BREAK-IN-LOCK.
payNote: Less than two days of a typical software developer's pay.
payNoteSource: BLS OEWS May 2025: software developers' median annual wage $135,980, about $523 per working day (260 days). Check the current release before changing.

prepared.reach: We find five fresh roles that fit you, who to look for on each team, and a short note to the hiring manager in your voice.
prepared.story: We rewrite your headline and the top of your resume from what you've told us, and flag any number we need you to confirm.
prepared.volume: Every weekday we line up fresh roles under your exact title, with what to lead with for each.
prepared.target: We compare your history with live postings and recommend the one title your experience supports best.
prepared.gap: We draft a "currently" line for your resume and LinkedIn from what you're building or learning.
prepared.proof: We give you the audit checklist, a report outline, where to find an AI-built app whose owner wants it checked, and a note to send them.
prepared.screen: We draft your 30-second answer to "tell me about yourself" for the role you want.
prepared.technical: We line up practice problems shaped like the round that stopped you.
prepared.final: We read what you tell us about your last final round and point to where it most likely slipped.
prepared.level: We find roles one level below your target to send alongside your usual ones.
